AboutPage.title: Building materials for real construction needs.
AboutPage.lead: Al-Hilal offers clay bricks, concrete bricks and blocks, curb stones and interlock paving for projects and contractors.
AboutPage.story: From masonry bricks to curb stones and interlock for exterior areas, Al-Hilal brings together product families with documented sizes and shapes to help teams identify materials for their projects.
AboutPage.production: According to the company profile, production uses modern lines, with sites near raw materials, expanding urban areas and large projects.
AboutPage.vision: Attention to manufacturing quality and Egyptian and international specifications, alongside direct delivery to project sites.

ProductsPage.title: Building materials catalogue
ProductsPage.lead: Explore product families and sizes documented in the company profile, then choose a product when preparing your request.
ProductsPage.note: Measurements are from the original profile; it does not state a length unit. Confirm final specifications before contracting.
ProductsPage.interlockNote: Various shapes, colors and sizes are available; describe what you need in the request.
ProductsPage.curbNote: Strength is specified against project requirements; no numerical value is published.
ProductsPage.modelNote: The 3D model illustrates the product family and does not guarantee the selected size.

QualityPage.title: The right specification begins with the right product.
QualityPage.lead: Al-Hilal's profile emphasizes product quality and Egyptian and international standards, and lists dimensions and properties for selected concrete products.
QualityPage.production: The production lines serve local market demand and large projects, according to the profile.
QualityPage.spec: The catalogue lists dimensions, weights and densities where provided by the source. Each project's requirements should be reviewed in the quote request.
QualityPage.scope: Curb stones are machine pressed and their strength depends on the required specification. We do not display undocumented test figures or certificates.

ProjectsPage.title: Supply relationships documented in the profile.
ProjectsPage.lead: The following names and projects appear in the supplied profile, and the owner confirmed they may be attributed to Al-Hilal. Supply scope, dates and quantities are not documented.
